entryPoint().notice: Returns the address of the EntryPoint v0.6.

implementation().notice: Returns the implementation of the ERC1967 proxy.

isOwnerBytes(bytes).notice: Checks if the given `account` bytes is registered as owner.

nextOwnerIndex().notice: Returns the next index that will be used to add a new owner.

ownerAtIndex(uint256).notice: Returns the owner bytes at the given `index`.

ownerCount().notice: Returns the current number of owners
